<plan>
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter kalika-farm
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 kalika-farm shivapuri-shelter
drive car1 shivapuri-shelter dupcheshwar-market
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer uttargaya-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 118

Notes on the plan:
- Shivapuri shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so all rescues end there. Dhunche temple is not used.
- The car rescues the 3 Kalika farm residents and the Dupcheshwar shopkeeper in one trip (7 + 7 + 32 + 32 = 78 minutes), filling its four seats.
- Reaching Uttargaya farm and returning costs 110 minutes, which is more than the 40-minute penalty for deferring its two shopkeepers. So those two are deferred.
- No families or people at Kispang care home are reported, so there is nothing to collect there.
- I assumed the listed roads can be driven in both directions, since the return legs depend on that.
